question: Analysis of one-way classified data is used to compare:
solution:
The correct answer is** several population means.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Analysis of one-way classified data is used to compare several population means:**

 
 
• In financial enterprises, one-way ANOVA (Analysis of Variance) is a statistical method used to compare the means of three or more independent groups to determine if there are any statistically significant differences between the means of the groups.
 
• This method is essential for comparing performance metrics, such as average returns of different investment portfolios, average sales figures across different regions, or average operational costs across various departments.
 
• By using one-way ANOVA, financial analysts can make informed decisions on resource allocation, investment strategies, and operational improvements based on the comparative analysis of multiple groups.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population standard deviations:**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because one-way ANOVA focuses on comparing means, not standard deviations. Standard deviations measure the dispersion or variability within a single dataset.
 
 
 
• **Population variances:**
 
 
• While ANOVA does involve variances in its calculations, its primary purpose is not to compare variances directly but to use them as a means to test the differences between group means.
 
 
 
• **Two population means:**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because the comparison of two population means is typically performed using a t-test, not ANOVA. One-way ANOVA is used when comparing more than two means.
